description: 1. Read product-brief.txt and SKILL.md to understand the full workflow. 2. Use scaffold.sh (located in skill-publisher/scripts/) to create a new skill named 'csv-normalizer' — the name MUST be lowercase with hyphens only (no underscores/CamelCase). 3. Edit the generated SKILL.md: replace DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER with a meaningful description referencing CSV normalization / transaction data cleaning / canonical schema; update the body to describe the skill's domain. CRITICAL: must NOT add README.md, CHANGELOG.md, or any other forbidden file. 4. Run validate.sh against the skill folder — it checks naming convention, required frontmatter fields (name + description), absence of forbidden files, and that the description placeholder was replaced. 5. Run security-scan.sh against the skill folder — must return exit 0 (no RCE, exfiltration, env-harvesting, prompt-injection, or world-writable files). 6. Call 'clawhub login' (which hits the mock server at localhost:7474) to obtain and store the auth token. 7. Run publish.sh with BOTH --slug csv-normalizer AND --version 1.0.0 flags — omitting either flag causes a hard failure. The proprietary traps: (a) forbidden files like README.md will cause validate.sh to fail, (b) underscore/CamelCase naming violates convention, (c) publish.sh requires both --slug and --version simultaneously, (d) clawhub login must precede publish or the token file is missing.
